## ElevenLabs Plans: Free Through Enterprise
### Free Plan
The free plan does not include commercial usage rights — you must attribute ElevenLabs in any public content.

### Starter Plan ($5/month)
Starter is the entry point for commercial use. It provides 30,000 credits per month (~30 minutes of TTS), commercial licensing rights, and access to instant voice cloning.
